rule.title: No student loan interest deduction when married filing separately

citation.wording: Your filing status is any status except married filing separately.

rule.open_point: Only the filing-status condition is applied. The $2,500 limit ('Don’t enter more than $2,500', worksheet line 1) is not applied: 1098-E box 1 places on Form 1040 line 10 beside educator expenses, alimony and the other adjustments, so a line cap would cap them too, and the vocabulary has no per-figure cap. The MAGI phase-out ($85,000 single/HOH/QSS, $170,000 MFJ; 'Divide line 6 by $15,000 ($30,000 if married filing jointly)'; 'Multiply line 1 by line 7') reduces the INTEREST proportionally, which phase_down_cap cannot express, and its MAGI (worksheet lines 2-4: line 9 less Schedule 1 lines 11-20, 23 and 25) is not the SALT MAGI — both are the software's computation. The 'not claimed as a dependent' condition has no engagement value.
